title: Erlang game leaderboard
context: Leaderboard helpers over a list of {PlayerId, Points} in submission order. ranked/1 sorts by points descending and ties keep submission order; top/2 returns the N best; page/3 returns 1-based page P of size Size; rank/2 returns a player's 1-based position or not_found.
code: submit({_Id, Points} = Entry, Scores) when is_integer(Points), Points >= 0 ->
lists:sort(fun({_, A}, {_, B}) -> A > B end, Scores).
page(P, Size, Scores) when P >= 1, Size >= 1 ->

expected.why: lists:sort/2 is only stable when the fun returns true for equal elements; with strict > ties are reordered, so use >=
pages are 1-based, so page P starts at (P - 1) * Size + 1; this skips the first page and is off by one
the position counter starts at 0, so ranks come out 0-based instead of 1-based
